taxesPaid.note: Judgement call: LVMH's cash-flow statement shows 'TOTAL TAX PAID (5,790)': 5,531 in operating activities plus 259 of tax on intra-Group dividends, which sits in financing inside 'Interim and final dividends paid' (7,322). notes: IFRS. Interest paid on debt and on leases (357 + 483) and operating tax paid (5,531) sit inside operating activities; only the 259 of dividend-related tax in financing is added. Capex uses gross PP&E and intangible purchases from note 15.3 rather than the net 'Operating investments' line. revenueIncludesExcise is null: the revenue policy (note 1.27) says revenue is net of all forms of discount but does not say whether excise duties on Wines and Spirits are included or deducted.
